objective: Preserve native task use while adding versioned stage SOP, scene-bound persistent graph plans and evidence-linked execution. No RAG-only causal claim.

comparison.online_agent: one persistent native CLI with native history/compaction; stage state recoverable through execution_status
comparison.wall_time_caveat: Concurrent wall time and provider load are not controlled causal speed measurements; report per-run topology.

development.repair_budget: At most two materially changed candidates after initial implementation; preserve every attempted case/revision, no same-revision retry. Standard layout 1 may be added when an actual failure requires a second development scene. No additional optional tuning after useful delivery.

regression_scope: Fixed historical cases reserved from this development round, selected by index before new trials; not previously unseen generalization holdout. Do not inspect their action traces for tuning before candidate freeze.

acceptance.functional: All three tasks have usable native scored episodes and coherent SOP-plan-execution evidence. Any incomplete/timeout remains explicit, not passed. Repair implementation faults before final frozen regression.
acceptance.effect: For each task every baseline-successful matched regression case must remain successful, with all 4 scored; candidate successes >= matched baseline. This strict engineering gate is not a statistical equivalence test.
acceptance.structure: One initial graph plan, normal actions/feedback/stage transitions do not create plan revisions; revisions carry explicit invalidation evidence, affected nodes and parent relationship. Every dispatched action has phase ownership, expected effect and actual evidence; completed phases have live evidence.
acceptance.cost: Report input, cached input, uncached input, output, reasoning breakdown, wall time, control steps, retrieval/reference/cache and planning/revision counts. Missing data stays unknown. Cost improvement only if comparable successful paired cases actually improve; no necessary numeric cost-win gate above effectiveness.
acceptance.default: Keep legacy as default throughout. A failed gate blocks default adoption; even all 12 passing only supports opt-in staged delivery plus an explicit limited-scope acceptance record. Broad default promotion requires a separately registered larger regression.

evidence.freeze: Commit candidate implementation before regression and archive full protocol_sources, SOP/sidecar versions, actual prompt, source/bank/scene hashes. Freeze cannot reuse prior performance for changed sources.
evidence.failures: Retain all failures, timeouts, partial costs and unscored attempts; no cherry-picking retries.
evidence.oracle: Only current RGB/calibration/proprioception and measurements derived from these enter policy. Native evaluation used offline only.
evidence.analysis: Offline complete information may explain development failures; fixes must address general problems. Final regression traces stay uninspected until frozen run completion; any later tuning needs a new validation protocol.
